speaker: Doctor
text: I see you recently had sinusitis treated with antibiotics, and now you have fatigue, flank pain, and fever. To determine if this has spread to your kidneys, could you tell me if you notice any changes in your urine, such as blood or cloudy appearance?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Has the flank pain become more severe on one side, and do you feel any shivers or chills? Also, have you noticed any difficulty urinating or a change in the frequency of your urination? REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis with culture; REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential.
